status: frozen before any training run of parts B and C
data: synthetic everywhere; nothing here is market data
protocol: #103's (experiments/m4_06/design.json, pinned below): its data for B, execution, fee rule and secondary fee, Box encoding with the reject policy, hyperparameter set, budget, training seeds, evaluation seed and bootstrap; one decision per row only

fee.source: #103's fee_rule.json at design version 2 (283d4d4): the largest candidate at which its Avellaneda-Stoikov point has a positive mean daily net on training days
fee.secondary: 0.0002, #103's fixed secondary row, on the holdout

market.data: synthetic: #103's 1 s queue-reactive days (3 regimes x 24), whose holdout #103 reads before this part's freeze; one policy per arm on the pooled training days, as #103

causal.data: synthetic: Hawkes market orders from examples/hawkes_days.rs moving the mid by a linear impact plus a diffusion of 1 tick per row, a one-tick spread; made-up parameters; 1 s rows as #103
causal.seed: 1000003 + day for the day's flow (buy side 2 x seed, sell side 2 x seed + 1) and diffusion, the same in every setting
causal.note: one policy per arm and impact setting, on that setting's training days
changes: before any training, after the queue check of training day 1: with a two-tick spread and a diffusion of 0.5 tick per row, the touch almost never crossed a quote, and Avellaneda-Stoikov filled 0 times at impact 0 and 0.25 even under immediate fill. The touch is now floor(mid) and one tick above it, and the diffusion 1 tick per row; the digests are regenerated.

window.rule: each market feature's normalized value and its presence flag are channels; ages are in decisions; the agent's values and flags are scalars; the windowed arms also see the current observation's market channels as they are

hsn.note: decays initialized at half-lives of 2 and 8 decisions, two of #103's EMA half-lives, and learned

parameters.rule: the windowed arms' policy and value MLPs have two hidden layers of the width whose trainable count is nearest #103's mlp; #103's arms keep their own and every count is reported

references.rule: no-trade, and Avellaneda-Stoikov and GLFT as zero residuals. B: the points #103's classical selection chose at one decision per row, per regime, pinned here. C: the step classical selects per impact setting on C's validation days, at the fee, by #103's rule over #103's grids, with the volatility from C's training days; its file is hashed into the freeze

decision_rule.against: the best non-HSN learned arm by mean daily net on validation, chosen before the holdout
decision_rule.interval: #103's 90 % block bootstrap over days on the paired daily difference, a learned arm's day being the mean over its seeds
decision_rule.hsn_helps: the lower bound is above 0, HSN has no limit breach, its mean max drawdown is at most drawdown_factor times the control's, and its interval against no-trade excludes 0
decision_rule.applied: B per regime and pooled, C per impact setting; at the chosen fee, and at #103's secondary 0.0002 beside it

audit.rule: a fixed set from the first validation day of the first group under a hold; two loads of every frozen checkpoint must give identical actions

compute.parallel: as the shared cap allows, agreed on the bus
compute.overrun_rule: a step that overruns its estimate by more than 50 % stops and is reported, without cutting seeds
compute.cut_rule: if compute forces a cut, C drops to impact 0 and 1.0 and one Hawkes decay before any seed is cut, and the design states it

seen_before_freeze: With an earlier draft at 10 s rows: one generation of the Hawkes days, and the mid range, the change of the mid per row and the touch sizes of training day 1 of each impact setting. No holdout or validation row was read.

Timing probes on 5000 synthetic rows (a random walk of the touch, not the design's data): 8192 PPO decisions of mlp, gru_window and hsn, timed and not evaluated (198, 534 and 246 microseconds a decision).
Smoke tests of every arm on 300 synthetic rows.

The queue check (check_queue.py) on training day 1 of every group of B and C: Avellaneda-Stoikov's fills and nets over #103's grid at 0.0002, under the design's fill model and under immediate fill (check_queue-market.json 7b6cf33f, check_queue-causal.json 84fee4e9).
#103's fee rule and classical selection results at fee -0.0001 as #103 reported them: training-day and validation means of its classical arms. No learned result of #103.

execution.rule: the standard set for every study on 1 s rows on 2026-11-07: one lot per 500 ms and no minimum time in queue. At one lot per 1000 ms an order requoted every 1 s row is 975 ms in queue at the next row and clears nothing; at 500 ms it clears one lot, and the touch ahead still binds. #103 adopts the same in its design version 2, and this part keeps whatever #103's base_config gives only if it equals this
execution.check: before any training, check_queue.py shows that Avellaneda-Stoikov fills on training days of every group and that its net differs from immediate fill

holdout_order: #103 reads the shared holdout days of part B before this part's freeze; this part's report says so, and its author does not look at #103's holdout results before this part's holdout run
